Type.evidence_source: For the analyses presented below, we used a pathways-to-care approach (Rogler & Cortes, 1994) as a conceptual framework for our data.

Area.evidence_source: Pathways to care refers to an approach that conceptualizes and analyzes the determinants and processes through which pa- tients attempt, or not, to receive health care. According to Rogler and Cortes (1993), pathways are "a series of contacts with individuals and organizations prompted by the distressed person's efforts, and those of significant others, to seek help as well as the help that is supplied in response to such efforts" (p. 555).
